definitions.gloss: broad classification, rough division, general categorization
definitions.explanation: Dividing things into a small number of major categories, as opposed to detailed or fine-grained classification. Used when giving an overview or simplified breakdown.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動詞|どうし}→動詞：03472_doushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大別|たいべつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{三種類|さんしゅるい}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese verbs can be broadly classified into three types.

examples.japanese: ⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大別|たいべつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{温帯|おんたい}→温帯：04479_ontai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{熱帯|ねったい}→熱帯：03531_nettai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}けられる→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧。
examples.english: Climates can be roughly divided into temperate and tropical.

examples.japanese: ⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大別|たいべつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{要因|よういん}→要因：05581_youin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: The causes can be broadly classified into two factors.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ in the pattern {大別|たいべつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ or {大別|たいべつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧, meaning "broadly classifying" or "roughly speaking." Common in academic writing, explanations, and presentations when giving a simplified categorization.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {大別|たいべつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: broadly classifying, roughly speaking
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{大別|たいべつ}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be broadly classified into ~
- {大別|たいべつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧～⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧: roughly ~ types/kinds

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{分類|ぶんるい}→分類：04790_bunrui⟧ is the general word for classification. {大別|たいべつ} specifically implies a rough, broad-stroke division into major categories.
